senses.gloss: लुठ् (I) vt. 1Ā (pres. लोठते) 1. To resist, to oppose; 2. to suffer pain; 3. to roll on the ground.
लुठ् (II) vt. 1P (pres. लोठति) To strike, to knock down.

लुठ् (III) vt. or vi. 6P (pres. लुठति) To roll, to roll about, to roll on the ground, त्वं पादांते लुठसि न च मे मन्युमोक्षः खलायाः Am.S.43, हारोऽयं हरिणाक्षीणां लुठति स्तनमंडलेन Am.S.100, लुठति धरणिशयने Git.G.v.With वि-, to roll about, to move to and fro on the ground.
लुठ् (IV) vt. 10U (pres. लोठयति-ते) To steal, to rob.
लुठित a. (f. ता) Rolled down, rolling on the ground.
लुठित a. (f. ता) Rolled down, rolling on the ground.
